The Switch Driver shall support the configuration of dropping double tagged frames via the configuration parameter EthSwtDropDoubleTagged if the Switch hardware supports dropping of double tagged frames.
If the parameter EthSwtDropDoubleTagged is set to TRUE , the double tagged frames shall be dropped independent on which Ethernet switch port this Ethernet frame has been received.
